title: Pocket Genes root service transaction v1.2.0
description: Strict root service_transactions record. outputReports is an optional supplemental output-only report link and never participates in the frozen service-offer object contract or transaction completion. Exact promised-object coverage and uploaded object/report readiness require semantic backend validation.

outputReports.description: Optional supplemental linked reports. Omitted, null, or empty means no report section. These links never satisfy outputSlots and never affect status or completeness.

moreInformation.description: Optional closed more-information map. Omission, null, an empty map, or only null/empty child sections produces no More information action.

stages.description: Complete sample-to-report offers must declare exactly test_planning, wet_lab, and bioinformatics.
Human advice and support offers must declare exactly the human_advice stage.
The human_advice stage is reserved for sot_human_advice_* categories.

timestamp.description: RFC 3339 JSON representation of a Firestore timestamp scalar; native SDK writers persist the corresponding Timestamp value.

output_report_snapshot.description: One supplemental output-only report link. The code resolves through report_codes and uploaded_reports; no report metadata is duplicated here.

snapshot_form_answer.description: One frozen answer in a transaction form snapshot.

snapshot_form_data.description: Frozen form content at transaction admission.

formShape.description: Frozen field definitions for the submitted form.

transaction_object_snapshot.description: Closed immutable object snapshot stored on a transaction input.

service_more_information_frequent_questi.description: One frequently asked question and its answer.

service_more_information_scientific_fact.description: One scientific fact relevant to the service.

description.description: Requester-facing explanation of the scientific fact.

url.description: Absolute HTTPS destination for the useful link. Lowercase https only; no userinfo; DNS/IPv4-label or bracketed-IPv6 host; optional numeric one-to-five-digit port; no whitespace.

service_more_information_sample_link.description: One featured sample resource and its action.

description.description: Requester-facing explanation of the sample resource.

buttonTitle.description: Action label used to open the sample resource.

url.description: Absolute HTTPS destination for the sample resource. Lowercase https only; no userinfo; DNS/IPv4-label or bracketed-IPv6 host; optional numeric one-to-five-digit port; no whitespace.

imageUrl.description: Absolute HTTPS URL for the segment image. Lowercase https only; no userinfo; DNS/IPv4-label or bracketed-IPv6 host; optional numeric one-to-five-digit port; no whitespace.

imageUploadDataUrl.description: Inline image data URL with an image media type and a nonempty base64 payload.

service_more_information_technical_fact.description: One technical-information fact with supporting points.

subitems.description: Ordered supporting technical points; an empty array is valid.

instructions.description: Instructions for satisfying the biological-sample requirement.

service_more_information.description: Optional presentation-only details for a published service offer. Every child key is optional and nullable; unknown keys are invalid.

frequentQuestions.description: Optional frequently asked questions; null or an empty array renders no section.

keyInsights.description: Optional key insights; null or an empty array renders no section.

scientificFacts.description: Optional scientific facts; null or an empty array renders no section.

usefulLinks.description: Optional useful links; null or an empty array renders no section.

sampleLink.description: Optional featured sample resource; null renders no section.

bulletSegments.description: Optional illustrated bullet segments; null or an empty array renders no section.

technicalInformationFacts.description: Optional technical facts; null or an empty array renders no section.

biologicalSampleRequirements.description: Optional biological-sample requirements; null or an empty array renders no section.

websiteUrl.description: Optional service website; null renders no section.

anyOf.description: Absolute HTTPS service website URL. Lowercase https only; no userinfo; DNS/IPv4-label or bracketed-IPv6 host; optional numeric one-to-five-digit port; no whitespace.
